# lab training-mode

<!-- Generated by `lab docs` from the commands' own help (cli/build.sh). Do not edit by hand:
     change the command's help text in cli/ and rebuild. -->

```text
on: llama-swap profile "training" on zaphod and marvin, every model it pins unloaded (running requests
to them are cut), then waits until zaphod's cards are <= 8 GB used each and marvin has >= 100 GB available.
The search and speech helpers stay. A training harness checks GET /api/profiles for active == "training".
off: profile off on both; models load again on their next request.
status (default): profile, loaded models and memory per host.
Don't mix with image-mode (one profile at a time). A llama-swap config reload switches the profile off and
reloads the preloaded models: run `lab training-mode on` again then.
Good result: on -> "training mode on: memory free" (2026-11-05: 1 s; card 1 7.5 GB, card 2 3.7 GB, marvin
120.5 GB available); off -> "profile off" twice.
```

Usage:

```
lab training-mode on|off|status [flags]
```

Options:

```
      --dry-run   show, change nothing (on/off)
```
